svg.text: Modules, key functions, the WebSocket protocol, and session state. shared/types.ts defines every type used on both sides.
opens WS, sends {start}; reconnects every 1.5 s, up to 60 s
builds transcript turns from ServerMessage deltas
80 ms tick: status, level meter, hints
no end-of-speech for 6 s (9 s extra time) → mic:false
returns start · submitText · request · integrity · end
attach(ws) / detach() new socket replaces old (4002)
onClient(msg) start · text · mic · integrity · request · end
AI delta → leak detector → retract + re-ask on hit
timers: ping 25 s · reconnect grace 90 s
absent limit 120 s · end after wrap-up 10 s
finish(reason) flush turns → persist → ended → report
create(candidate) randomUUID · 24-byte token · store sha256 only
persist(id) debounce 500 ms · write tmp → rename (atomic)
boot: active/created → abandoned · pending report → failed
binary PCM16 mono 16 kHz, ~100 ms frames
